label: DailyEnergyFlowState
info:
Reads Daily Energy Flow State from registers:
- 514-515: Battery charge/discharge
- 520-521: Grid import/export
- 526: Load
- 529-533: PV total + MPPT 1-4
- 536: Generator

Triggers:
1. Daily at 23:59
2. Manual
3. RPC: getDailyEnergyFlowState

name: Route to both reads
Prepare read (Batt/Grid/Load 514-526)
Prepare read (PV/Gen 529-536)
Build DailyEnergyFlowState JSON
Check if RPC
